guide.save_resume_behavior: Your progress saves automatically within the game. You can ascend chambers at your own pace. Achievements and your Reasoning Signature are preserved.
guide.privacy_statement: All gameplay data stays in your browser. No data is sent externally or used for analysis. Your reasoning patterns are private to you.
guide.reset_behavior: You can reset Mental Ingenuity and start fresh. Resetting clears all chamber progress and achievements. Exported Reasoning Signatures are saved separately.
guide.product_boundaries: Mental Ingenuity is an educational interactive game focused on reasoning practice. It does not assess intelligence, diagnose cognitive abilities, or provide clinical evaluation.
